column1: # Built-in medical and care terms (ne -> ja), see terms_builtin_ja_ne.tsv. Verbs are given in their
# dictionary form (むせる, not むせました): the model conjugates them, and a conjugated hint came out twice (むせましました).
# A Nepali term ending in ~ is a verb stem and matches every conjugation (सर्कि~ = सर्कियो, सर्किनुभयो ...).
